title: Lucid Nightmare
flavor: When the gods have nightmares, it is Bane Elemental who brings them. Also known as Atropos, Bane was born from the midnight terrors of the goddess Nyctasha. A force of terror too powerful to be contained by sleep, he surfaced from her slumbers, fed upon her immortality, and stole his vaporous form from her inky blood. He is the essence of fear.

entries.name: Added a bar graph of economic results to show players, allowing a clear view of lineup value on the right-side player detail panel and the endgame panel
Bane($1, Satyr/Warlock)
entries.detail: New chess piece. <Active Skill: Activates on Full Mana> Casting Spell: Grabs a random enemy chess piece, rendering it unable to act and dealing pure damage over time. Victims of Atropos often suffer excruciating agony from the vivid illusions in their nightmares.

entries.name: Chiaroscuro Certainty
entries.detail: Effect reworked Grant loot tokens when the relic disappears, with token level determined by the highest reward/compensation during the holding period (removed the restriction of not being able to obtain level 3 tokens before round 25). Your win/loss streak will additionally earn 1 gold, and when the relic disappears, you will receive a corresponding level loot token based on the highest reward/compensation held during that time. Note: 2-4 win/loss streak corresponds to level 1 loot token, 5-9 win/loss streak corresponds to level 2 loot token, and 10+ win/loss streak corresponds to level 3 loot token.
